title: Histos Harmonia's engine, and the coasts for its map
about: The engine is a program around the API's compositions of historical objects (the history domain, with kategoria's verdict), of tunings (musicology) and of argument maps (philosophy), compiled once with g++ 11 or later, natively or in WSL, into data/cache/engines/histos-harmonia/. About three minutes; it is compiled again when its sources change. The map draws present coasts from Natural Earth when the data library has fetched them, and a bare graticule when it has not.
